question: Can an original festival programme identify the film in Abhyasa's reported school screening of The Waterfall?
finding: The official IKFF India 2017 trailer explicitly credits Lipika Singh Darai. Its festival card matches the 14–19 November 2017 edition reported by Abhyasa. This supplies a cross-source identity bridge; the completed school screening remains a school-reported event.

sources.title: The Waterfall | IKFF India 2017
sources.publisher: SCIFF - School Cinema International Film Festival
sources.evidence: Original rendered description explicitly credits Lipika Singh Darai. The closing card, independently verified by Drishti at 1:20, displays International Kids Film Festival India, 14 to 19 November 2017.
sources.inspection: Anvesha inspected the description and a sampled closing frame, initially reporting an approximate 1:12 locator. Disha separately inspected the exact original watch-page title, description and upload date in the in-app browser. Drishti independently verified the description and the date card at 1:20; use this confirmed locator.
sources.limits: Trailer, not full-film viewing. Upload date follows the festival dates. No school attendance or outcome evidence in this source.

sources.evidence: Retained school-authored indexed report lists The Waterfall among senior films at the 14–19 November 2017 festival; Darai is separately listed among directors.
sources.inspection: Reused earlier original-domain indexed body; current live body still inaccessible. Current school archive retains the event link.
sources.limits: School testimony, not independently observed screening; no direct school-authored title/director pair, exact film day, version, film-specific attendance or payment.

sources.evidence: PDF 86 reports The Waterfall in the first day of a 19 July 2024 school festival. PDF 87–88 show the festival and workshop, without a readable film-identifying credit.
sources.inspection: Disha visually read full PDF pages 85–89; pages 85, 87, 88 and 89 extend earlier page 86 inspection.
sources.limits: Darai identity remains unresolved for this different festival. Do not identify the visible train-window frame as The Waterfall.

editorial_decision.candidate: Abhyasa’s account of its November 2017 school festival lists The Waterfall among the films shown. The festival’s own trailer identifies Lipika Singh Darai as the director.
editorial_decision.note: Abhyasa school festival report, 14–19 November 2017; SCIFF, The Waterfall | IKFF India 2017, 29 December 2017.
editorial_decision.reason: This is a bounded research cycle. Preserve the separate active public-article scope; integrate this evidence in a subsequent single-article revision.
editorial_decision.review: PASS for two separately attributed statements; no further user approval required for the research result. Public integration must respect existing article ownership.
